parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, narrow component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of durable plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the eyeglasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge joint attached to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding similar to the left leg.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, consisting of the frame that holds the lenses and connects to the legs. The frame is typically plastic, while the lenses are glass or polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the corrective or protective lenses in place and provides the structural foundation for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the central support to which the legs are hinged.
